updates: Extends actual stream-parser contracts beyond the UTF-8 adapter into concrete inline parsing and its shared output type.
properties: Construction starts with empty pending text and no active tag.
On normal return, finish clears pending text and the active tag.
finish emits exactly one extraction iff a tag was active at entry; it returns empty visible text for that case and the exact entry pending text otherwise.
StreamTextChunk default is empty; is_empty exactly reflects visible text and extracted-item count.
The suffix helper returns a byte count bounded by the input and strictly below a nonempty delimiter length; that count is a delimiter UTF-8 boundary.
Checked lemmas call the real finish implementation to prove reset state and that a second finish produces no duplicate output.
readability: Short imported requires/ensures/refined/may_panic forms; Option fields use is_some/is_none with Rust type witnesses, and string slices support is_char_boundary. Lemmas are ordinary Rust functions. cfg_attr wrappers remain.
model_trust: Audited String empty/clear/length/dereference/concatenation facts, usize/i32 inclusive-range envelope bounds, and delegated Rev bounds. Bounds models grant no exact size/exhaustion capability. Literal &str Pattern has a panic capability but no matching-content relation. See Flux handoff/COLLECTION-MODELS.md.
panic_scope: Constructor validation, callbacks, allocation, and generic Drop can panic. Parser trait declarations explicitly allow panics; implementation postconditions cover normal returns. No catch-unwind state guarantee or complete destructor-effect proof is claimed.
